description: This file defines the 'Operation' class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing an API operation with methods to access HTTP details, input/output shapes, errors, and context parameters.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Represents an API operation with methods to retrieve HTTP info, input/output shapes, errors, and context parameters.

methods.name: getHttp
methods.description: Returns an array of HTTP method and request URI for the operation.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the input shape of the operation.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Returns the output shape of the operation.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns an array of error shapes for the operation.

methods.name: getStaticContextParams
methods.description: Returns static context parameters used for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Returns dynamic context parameters used for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: setContextParams
methods.description: Private method to set context parameters based on input shape members.
